newsitem.title: UK: UK's FTSE 100 falls one pct, hit by futures.
newsitem.headline: UK's FTSE 100 falls one pct, hit by futures.

text.p: Britain's leading share index fell one percent in thin early afternoon activity, tracking a selloff in futures after the index options expiry.
At 1155 GMT, the FTSE 100 was off 49.9 points at 4,941.4 after hitting 4,941.1, its weakest level since August 5.
Decliners led advancers by 69 to 25 and volume was 415.3 million, with holidays across much of Europe on Friday limiting trading.
The FTSE 250, however, continued to outperform, as the manufacturers continue to catch up to the big blue-chip stocks.
The broader index was up 21.5 points or 0.46 percent at 4,711.4, the strongest since mid-March when it touched its all-time best of 4,736.2.
The September futures contract traded at a sharp discount to cash, and was down 68 points at 4,934.
